summary: ZenaTech, a Vancouver-based Nasdaq-listed AI drone and DaaS company, filed a 6-K reporting the close of its 29th Drone-as-a-Service acquisition, a Georgia-based U.S. land surveying company holding licenses in 17 states, adding solar and railroad customers; the filing also covers Irish Aviation Authority SORA approval for ZenaDrone crop and soil nutrient application and selection for Canada's Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace. No purchase price, stake percentage, board recommendation, advisor, or close date was disclosed. The acquisition advances an acquisition-led DaaS roll-up consolidating fragmented legacy service industries, integrating licensed surveying capabilities with drone services. Watch for subsequent 6-Ks disclosing deal economics and revenue contribution.
